purpose: Prevent market-specific DEVELOPMENT winners from advancing as if they were generalizable edges.

interpretation.positive_return_markets: At least four of six market/timeframe observations must have net return above zero after modeled costs.
interpretation.positive_sharpe_markets: At least four of six observations must have Sharpe above zero.
interpretation.policy_eligible_markets: At least three observations must independently satisfy the existing DEVELOPMENT selection policy.
interpretation.robust_markets: At least two observations must independently pass existing walk-forward and stress robustness.
interpretation.distinct_robust_symbols: Robust passes must span at least two underlying assets; two timeframes of BTC alone are insufficient.
interpretation.median_sharpe: The median Sharpe across all six observations must be at least 0.25.
interpretation.worst_net_return: No single market/timeframe observation may lose more than 5% over the frozen DEVELOPMENT window.
interpretation.drawdown: Maximum observed DEVELOPMENT drawdown across the six markets may not exceed 25%.

anti_data_snooping_rules: These breadth thresholds may not be weakened after Experiment C results are observed and then represented as preregistered.
Experiment A and B are not retroactively rejected or accepted by this policy; their evidence remains frozen under the rules that existed when they ran.
Any material change to these thresholds creates a new named experiment version with a new policy fingerprint and a fresh candidate universe.
Experiment C candidate families and dimensions must be frozen before any Experiment C DEVELOPMENT campaign is executed.
Protected HOLDOUT remains inaccessible during Experiment C DEVELOPMENT research.
next_required_step: Define and freeze the Experiment C candidate-family universe under this policy before running any Experiment C market data campaign.
